notes: Official Oporto Australia nutrition and allergen page links the current allergen chart and says nutrition is based on standardized recipes, average figures, and may vary by store, hand portioning, seasonal ingredients, and custom orders.
Oporto's official public menu/feed exposes kJ and calories, but no protein values were found in the official Australian pages, current allergen PDF, embedded menu JSON, or site bundles checked.
The current official allergen chart, linked from Oporto's nutrition page, lists Veggie Burger, Vegan Burger, Vegan Rappa, and Vegan Bowl; it is marked information correct as at 29.06.26.

The sampled official pickup menu feed for Chatswood Westfield on 2026-07-05 listed Veggie Burger at 2180 kJ / 521 kcal and Add Extra Veggie Pattie at 690 kJ / 165 kcal, but did not list Vegan Burger, Vegan Rappa, or Vegan Bowl for that store.
Protein values below are included only where an explicit macro source was found. Item source_url points to that macro source; notes identify the official Oporto support separately.

Strict vegetarian and allergen users should be warned: Oporto's allergen chart says products may be prepared on shared equipment, and Veggie Patties may be cooked in a shared fryer vat with chicken items.

base_items.notes: Official current menu feed for a sampled AU store lists Veggie Burger as fresh lettuce, tomato, cheese, mayo, and lemon and herb sauce at 2180 kJ / 521 kcal. Protein is from FatSecret's Oporto Veggie Burger entry, which reports 520 kcal, 11.2 g protein, and 251 g serving size; calorie value in this proposal uses the current official Oporto feed. Contains dairy/egg ingredients, so vegetarian but not vegan.

CalorieKing Australia reports 1 burger, 307 g serving, 2702 kJ / 646 kcal and 15.7 g protein. Oporto's current official allergen chart lists Vegan Burger, but the sampled official pickup menu feed did not list it for the tested store, so availability may vary.

CalorieKing Australia reports 1 wrap, 333 g serving, 2564 kJ / 613 kcal and 14.7 g protein. Oporto's current official allergen chart lists Vegan Rappa, but the sampled official pickup menu feed did not list it for the tested store, so availability may vary.

Eats Bible reports 1 bowl, 522 g serving, 1860 kJ / 440 kcal and 17 g protein, with vegan patty, mixed lettuce leaves, lettuce, cabbage blend, dry slaw, Portuguese tomato salad, guacamole, and Green Goddess dressing. Oporto's current official allergen chart lists Vegan Bowl, but the sampled official pickup menu feed did not list it for the tested store, and FatSecret marks its similar Vegan Bowl entry as archived.
